description: University Grants Commission - Amendment to the Ordinance of the Open University of Sri Lanka published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 591/18 of 05.01.1990
categorisation: This gazette content contains an ordinance made by the University Grants Commission amending the Open University of Sri Lanka Ordinance. It involves legal amendments to existing legislation (Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978 and Open University of Sri Lanka Ordinance), which falls under the Legal/Regulatory category (Type 5) for regulatory matters and statutory instruments. The content does not involve government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or any of the other specialized categories.
